goal: Given frozen native EOG candidate graph rules and separately DECLARED directed-edge observations, calculate how filtering graph rules narrows or fails to narrow possible fixed-source origins without conflating true structural nonedges with field species nondetections or assuming a graph true.
distinct_from_prior: Existing v6-v8 prior world expansion/threat count work is frozen; not rescored
Existing v7 target-aware evidence planning is a separate frozen, target-conditional adaptive action experiment and not rerun
Existing PR #698 source-hypothesis projection gave 48 graph/source pairs with three possible sources; this gate adds an explicit external edge measurement condition only.

graph_universe.EOG_operator: build_dynamic_transition_operator (geographic_support=1 for active edges, loss_support=1) and max_steps=1
graph_universe.provenance_requirement: Every edge observation has non-empty evidence_ref and evidence_basis exactly synthetic_known_truth or declared_external_structural_assessment. The latter is an UNVERIFIED CALLER ASSERTION, not authenticated field evidence.
graph_universe.source_rule_projections: Use existing audit_fixed_source_hypotheses plus summarize_fixed_source_hypothesis_identifiability on same graphs before and retained graphs after declarations; no new graph/rule fits
fail_closed: empty rule universe should be STOP not source identified

scientific_limits: A field non-detection is never an independently established unavailable dispersal edge.
The API can only audit edge evidence declarations and provenance strings; it cannot verify ecological impossibility, physical barrier closure, ancestral status or the source provenance itself.
All posterior/likelihood, EOG-WF predictive fit and actual finite ecological movement-world claims STOP.
A unique source under declared graphs and asserted structural edge evidence is not a demonstrated biological founder.
No newly opened responses, no fourth EOG-WF scored endpoint; keep 3 scored/31 scientific STOP/3 admin exclusions, PRs #697/#698 Draft and unmerged.
